a0_state_discovery.rule: Rule 21 A.0 — run directly this session; both subagent probe fleets died on a spend cap returning nothing.
findings: Owner item 1 is NOT a click bug: headless-Chromium matrix (solo|bots x 1920x1080|1536x864|1366x768) shows hitTest returns the SPEED button, cursor=pointer, and the click WORKS (score 100->50, speedLevel 0->1). The real defect is BUY GATHERER disabled from t=0 with no stated reason (STARTING_VICTORY_POINTS=100 vs GATHERER_PRICE=105) plus near-zero early income (complexity 0 => solo score sat at 50 through tick 5580).

FALSE REPRO CAUGHT: the first run showed the click dead, caused by ?debug=1 whose DOM panel (fixed, z-index 1001, rect 1471,230->1896,1202) covers both buttons. The whole e2e harness boots ?debug=1, so it could never have caught a footer click regression.

Owner item 3 ROOT CAUSE: depositSlot (gathererLifecycle.ts:259-269) indexes by COUNTING currently-banked sparks, so any hole collapses the mapping and a later deposit lands exactly on an occupied slot. The fling is collision.ts:36 resolvePair — exact co-location early-returns on distSq<EPSILON (inert stack), but once a grab perturbs the pair, dist~0 with overlap~minDist/2 applies a near-maximal positional correction that Verlet converts to a large velocity.

Banked shapes are real freeSparks physics entities (escrow:banked, spark.ts:47-57); the escrow===undefined tests at physicsLoop.ts:226,242,248 exempt them only from the soft cap and TTL reap, NOT from collision.

Recipe sizes verified against the real registry: pentagram 5, lightningHub 6, Helga 7, Voltkin 8, laserTurret 8 — plus an UNDOCUMENTED 6th exact-size gate, NONET at 9 (sudokuEvent.ts:20), missing from the bank-cap table.

R8 verified: exactly ONE production tickBuildAction call site (placePrimitive.ts:584); PLACE_FROM_FREE delegates to placePrimitive (placeFromFree.ts:244), so a bank-place path routed through it keeps earning disruption charges.

Sim-worker flip: 6 ?worker=1 literals across 4 files (BACKLOG says 5 files); probeHarness.ts:340 REFUSES TO ARM when the flag is set (becomes refuse-by-default after a flip); 6 non-worker-only main-thread paths exist.
e2e has ZERO gatherer/footer-control coverage — the reason this shipped unverifiable.

owner_rulings_s134.B4_directives: AMENDED — an ordered RTS-style BUILD QUEUE of individual primitives, NOT a filter.
